rappel_detail.anchor: slung tree at the middle summit
rappel_detail.station: Guye’s middle summit, reached by traversing the connecting ridge from the south summit.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, about 30 m, onto the east side of the middle summit. Then ascend the ramp to the north summit; the Southeast Couloir drops off to the left just before it.
hazards: Fixed tat: inspect it before weighting it.
